map.非标准状态下的电极电势 使用指南: Electrode potential under non-standard conditions guide
map.输入标准电极电势、转移电子数 n、反应商 Q 与温度，按能斯特方程求非标准状态下: Enter the standard electrode potential, number of electrons transferred n, reaction quotient Q and temperature to find the actual electrode potential under non-standard conditions via the Nernst equation, for electrochemical analysis.
map.E = E° − (RT/nF)lnQ。25℃ 时 2.303RT/F≈0.05: E = E° - (RT/nF)lnQ. At 25 C, 2.303RT/F is about 0.0592 V. When Q=1, E=E°.
map.输入标准电势、电子数 n、反应商 Q 与温度，求实际电极电势。: Enter standard potential, electron number n, reaction quotient Q and temperature to get the actual electrode potential.
map.填写「电子转移数 n」。: Fill in "number of electrons transferred n".
map.电池电势：由 E°、n、Q 算实际 E，评估输出电压。: Cell potential: compute actual E from E°, n and Q to evaluate the output voltage.
map.浓差电池：由两端浓度差算电动势。: Concentration cell: compute the electromotive force from the concentration difference between the two sides.
map.平衡判定：Q=K 时 E=0，反应达平衡。: Equilibrium check: when Q=K, E=0 and the reaction has reached equilibrium.
map.：输入 E°=−0.76 V、n=2、[Zn²⁺]=0.01 M、T=298K，: : entering E° = -0.76 V, n = 2, [Zn2+] = 0.01 M, T = 298 K, the tool outputs E about -0.82 V and notes that half-reactions containing H+ vary with pH.
map.道尔顿分压（Pᵢ = xᵢ · P_总）: Dalton's law of partial pressure (P_i = x_i x P_total)
map.由酸解离常数与浓度估算 pH: Estimate pH from the acid dissociation constant and concentration
map.转移电子数，由半反应配平得。: Number of electrons transferred, obtained by balancing the half-reaction.
map.是，273+℃，影响 RT/nF 项。: Yes, 273 + degrees C, affecting the RT/nF term.
map.含 H⁺/OH⁻ 的半反应，Q 含 [H⁺]，E 随 pH 变。: For half-reactions containing H+/OH-, Q contains [H+], so E varies with pH.
